# Historical source-query contracts

These hand-authored synthetic contract fixtures are not extracted repository
graphs. Their illustrative source anchors and digests do not establish native
AST ownership. Native publication/query tests cover that boundary separately.

The byte-pinned samples preserve profiles1–6 without using whichever profile
is current. Alpha and note contribute document frequencies in every profile;
omega becomes lexical only in profiles5–6. Nested inner text and the profile6
parameter binding block never contribute a document frequency.

Do not regenerate these files to bless a reader change. Preserve historical
meaning and add a separately versioned sample for new contracts.
